newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein soft in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein soft in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices remained soft in late trading on Monday on thin buying interest amid state intervention selling, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,430-35 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,425. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,250 rupiah/kg in Medan.
"The market is quiet, due in part to the market operations by (state logistics agency) BULOG," one trader said.
"Players are not keen to take positions because they feel prices could weaken further if the market operations continue. This possibility is there unless demand improves," he said.
Traders said they expected consumer demand to improve this week, as Moslems preparing for the Eid al-Fitr celebrations begin to stock up cooking oil.
"Demand usually picks up two weeks ahead of Lebaran (Eid al-Fitr)," one trader said. "But this did not materialise today. The market was pretty quiet."
Traders also said the relatively high price of crude palm oil was keeping margins on olein slim, adding that refiners would be losing money if olein prices did not rise.
